questionText: ACROSS (8 letters): The quality of being morally good: I_T_G_I_Y
explanation: INTEGRITY means the quality of being honest and having strong moral principles. I-N-T-E-G-R-I-T-Y.

questionText: DOWN (11 letters): Capable of being changed: M_D_F_A_L_
explanation: MODIFIABLE means able to be changed or adjusted. M-O-D-I-F-I-A-B-L-E.

questionText: Fill in: A word meaning to make something unclear: O_S_U_C_T_
explanation: Both OBFUSCATE (to confuse) and OBSCURE (to make unclear) mean to make something difficult to understand. Both fit the clue.

questionText: ACROSS (12 letters): The coexistence of different cultures: M_L_I_U_T_R_L
explanation: MULTICULTURAL means relating to or containing several cultural groups. M-U-L-T-I-C-U-L-T-U-R-A-L.

questionText: Word game: What word connects OVER, DOWN, and UP to make compound words?
explanation: LOAD connects: OVERLOAD DOWNLOAD UPLOAD - all are valid compound words.

questionText: DOWN (14 letters): The ability to feel what others feel: E_P_T_E_I_A_L_Y
explanation: EMPATHETICALLY means in a way that shows empathy or understanding of others feelings. E-M-P-A-T-H-E-T-I-C-A-L-L-Y.

questionText: Fill in: A word meaning to secretly listen to conversations: E_V_S_R_P
explanation: EAVESDROP means to listen secretly to a conversation. E-A-V-E-S-D-R-O-P.

questionText: ACROSS (10 letters): The study of signs and symbols: S_M_O_O_Y
explanation: SEMIOLOGY or SEMIOTICS is the study of signs and symbols and their use or interpretation. S-E-M-I-O-L-O-G-Y.

questionText: Word game: Which word can precede OVER SCAPE and MARK?
explanation: LAND connects: LANDOVER LANDSCAPE LANDMARK - all valid compound words.

questionText: Fill in: A word meaning excessive self-love or admiration: N_R_I_S_S_
explanation: NARCISSISM means excessive admiration of oneself. N-A-R-C-I-S-S-I-S-M. Double S is key.

questionText: ACROSS (13 letters): The study of moral principles: P_I_O_O_H_C_L
explanation: PHILOSOPHICAL means relating to philosophy or showing wisdom. P-H-I-L-O-S-O-P-H-I-C-A-L.

questionText: DOWN (11 letters): Impossible to satisfy: I_S_T_A_L_
explanation: INSATIABLE means impossible to satisfy. I-N-S-A-T-I-A-B-L-E. Note SATI in the middle.

questionText: Fill in: A word meaning relating to sound: A_O_S_I_
explanation: ACOUSTIC means relating to sound or hearing. A-C-O-U-S-T-I-C.

questionText: ACROSS (9 letters): The process of careful examination: S_R_T_N_
explanation: SCRUTINY means close careful examination. S-C-R-U-T-I-N-Y.

questionText: Word game: What word can follow HAND SUIT and BOOK to make compound words?
explanation: CASE follows: HANDCASE SUITCASE BOOKCASE - SUITCASE and BOOKCASE are valid. HANDCASE is less common. CASE is the best answer.

questionText: DOWN (12 letters): A formal enumeration of items: C_T_L_G_I_G
explanation: Both CATALOGUING (British) and CATALOGING (American) are correct spellings of the present participle of catalog/catalogue.

questionText: Fill in: A word meaning to officially ban something: P_O_C_I_E
explanation: PROSCRIBE means to officially forbid something. P-R-O-S-C-R-I-B-E. Prescribe means to recommend or order (medicine).

questionText: ACROSS (10 letters): Complete destruction: A_N_H_L_T_O_
explanation: ANNIHILATION means complete destruction. A-N-N-I-H-I-L-A-T-I-O-N. Double N is important.

questionText: Word game: What word can precede POOL SIDE and SUIT to make compound words?
explanation: SWIM connects: SWIMPOOL (less common) SWIMSIDE and SWIMSUIT. Actually SWIM: SWIMSUIT is most common. BATH: BATHPOOL BATHSIDE BATHSUIT. SWIM connects best with swimsuit.

questionText: Fill in: A word meaning relating to the origin of words: E_Y_O_O_I_A_
explanation: ETYMOLOGICAL means relating to etymology the study of word origins. E-T-Y-M-O-L-O-G-I-C-A-L.

questionText: DOWN (8 letters): A formal accusation: I_D_C_M_N_
explanation: INDICTMENT means a formal accusation of a serious crime. I-N-D-I-C-T-M-E-N-T. Note the silent C before T.

questionText: Fill in: A word meaning to stir up public feelings: I_C_T_
explanation: INCITE means to encourage or stir up violent or unlawful behavior. I-N-C-I-T-E.

questionText: ACROSS (11 letters): The state of being confused: P_R_L_X_T_
explanation: PERPLEXITY means inability to deal with or understand something. P-E-R-P-L-E-X-I-T-Y.

questionText: Word game: What word can follow BLACK BLUE and RED to describe types of print?
explanation: PRINT follows: BLACKPRINT BLUEPRINT REDPRINT. Actually BLUEPRINT is the most common compound. BLUE + PRINT = BLUEPRINT is clearly the target.

questionText: Fill in: A word meaning very complicated and difficult: C_N_O_U_E_
explanation: CONVOLUTED means extremely complex and difficult to follow. C-O-N-V-O-L-U-T-E-D.

questionText: DOWN (9 letters): The practice of using symbols: S_M_O_I_M
explanation: SYMBOLISM means the use of symbols to represent ideas. S-Y-M-B-O-L-I-S-M.

questionText: Fill in: A word meaning to make weaker: E_F_E_L_
explanation: ENFEEBLE means to make someone weak. E-N-F-E-E-B-L-E.

questionText: ACROSS (8 letters): Showing great courage: V_L_A_T
explanation: VALIANT means possessing great courage. V-A-L-I-A-N-T.

questionText: Word game: Unscramble AELSTRU to find a word meaning neutral or not taking sides.
explanation: NEUTRAL rearranges from AELNRTU. It means not supporting either side. N-E-U-T-R-A-L.

questionText: Fill in: A word meaning to officially support or endorse: S_N_T_O_
explanation: SANCTION as a verb means to officially permit or endorse something. S-A-N-C-T-I-O-N.

questionText: DOWN (12 letters): An expert in linguistic meaning: S_M_N_I_I_T
explanation: A SEMANTICIST is an expert in semantics - the study of meaning. S-E-M-A-N-T-I-C-I-S-T.

questionText: Fill in: A word meaning tending to avoid extremes: M_D_R_T_
explanation: MODERATE means avoiding extremes. M-O-D-E-R-A-T-E.

questionText: ACROSS (10 letters): A natural ability for something: P_O_I_I_N_Y
explanation: PROFICIENCY means a high degree of skill or expertise. P-R-O-F-I-C-I-E-N-C-Y.

questionText: Word game: Unscramble AERMNOT to find a word related to speaking.
explanation: TORMENT rearranges from AERMNOT. While ORATION is related to speaking AERMNOT letters rearrange to TORMENT.

questionText: Fill in: A word meaning unclear or having multiple meanings: A_B_G_O_S
explanation: AMBIGUOUS means having more than one possible meaning. A-M-B-I-G-U-O-U-S.

questionText: DOWN (9 letters): The quality of deserving trust: C_E_I_I_I_Y
explanation: CREDIBILITY means the quality of being trusted and believed. C-R-E-D-I-B-I-L-I-T-Y.

questionText: Fill in: A word meaning to give a choice between alternatives: O_T_O_
explanation: OPTION means a thing that is or may be chosen. O-P-T-I-O-N.

questionText: ACROSS (11 letters): State of uncertainty: A_B_V_L_N_E
explanation: AMBIVALENCE means having mixed feelings about something. A-M-B-I-V-A-L-E-N-C-E.

questionText: Word game: What word can follow BOOK PLAY and TIME to make compound words?
explanation: KEEPER follows: BOOKKEEPER GOALKEEPER or PLAYKEEPER TIMEKEEPER - BOOKKEEPER and TIMEKEEPER are both valid compound words.

questionText: Fill in: A word meaning to change ones beliefs due to pressure: C_P_T_L_T_
explanation: CAPITULATE means to cease resistance and surrender to demands. C-A-P-I-T-U-L-A-T-E.

questionText: DOWN (10 letters): A person who specializes in a field: S_E_I_L_S_
explanation: SPECIALIST means a person highly skilled in a specific area. S-P-E-C-I-A-L-I-S-T.

questionText: Fill in: A word meaning the quality of being resilient: T_N_C_T_
explanation: TENACITY means the quality of being very determined. T-E-N-A-C-I-T-Y.

questionText: ACROSS (8 letters): To make a formal speech: O_A_I_N
explanation: ORATION means a formal speech. O-R-A-T-I-O-N.

questionText: Word game: What word connects KNOW HOW EVER and WHEN to make compound words?
explanation: WHERE connects: KNOWWHERE (NOWHERE) HOWEVER WHEREVER WHENEVER - Actually WHEREVER WHEREVER not exactly. WHERE: WHEREVER WHEREVER. EVER: HOWEVER WHEREVER WHENEVER WHEREVER is best.

questionText: Fill in: A word meaning to correct mistakes in a text: P_O_F_E_D
explanation: PROOFREAD means to read and correct errors in text. P-R-O-O-F-R-E-A-D.

questionText: DOWN (9 letters): A term for systematic examination: E_A_U_T_O_
explanation: EVALUATION means a systematic examination or assessment. E-V-A-L-U-A-T-I-O-N.

questionText: Fill in: A word meaning to deliberately mislead: M_S_E_D
explanation: MISLEAD means to cause someone to have a wrong impression. M-I-S-L-E-A-D.

questionText: ACROSS (11 letters): Relating to a nation as a whole: N_T_O_W_D_
explanation: NATIONWIDE means throughout an entire nation. N-A-T-I-O-N-W-I-D-E.

questionText: Word game: Unscramble INEFADCN to find a word meaning trust in someone.
explanation: DEFIANCE rearranges from INEFADC + extra letters. From INEFADCN the rearrangement gives DEFIANCE (going against authority). D-E-F-I-A-N-C-E.

questionText: Fill in: A word meaning to draw conclusions from evidence: I_F_R
explanation: INFER means to conclude from evidence. I-N-F-E-R. You infer a conclusion from available evidence.
